//: The browser app. Separate from tsconfig.web.json because that one builds the
developer harness and the two must not share an output directory: they compile
the same sim modules and a shared outDir would make one overwrite the other's
sourcemap paths, which is exactly the kind of quiet coupling this repository
`include` names entry points only. tsc follows imports, so packages/bench and
packages/solver arrive through packages/web without being listed — and without
dragging in the bench modules that open node:fs, which would compile fine and
then fail at runtime in a tab.
